notes.title: Demo Co-op update!
notes.notes:
[p]Co-op play has now been added to the demo!

There is also a bunch of new content added to the demo including new equipment, enemies, and mission modifiers.[/p]

notes.title: Vortica Demo is Here! Play Now!
notes.notes:
The wait is over, Vortica's demo is now live! Step into a solar system overrun by alien horrors, take on intense missions, hunt for powerful equipment, and fight for survival.

🌀 What to Expect in the Demo:
✅ Action-packed combat with deadly enemies.
✅ Infinitely re-playable procedurally generated missions filled with challenge and reward.
✅ Powerful weapons and upgrades to customize your playstyle.
✅ A glimpse into the full Vortica experience.

Your feedback is crucial as we prepare for launch, so jump in, play the demo, and let us know what you think!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3538260/Vortica_Demo/

notes.title: Introducing Vortica - A Sci-fi Roguelite Adventure
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I am thrilled to announce my brand new game, Vortica! After almost 6 years of hard work, it's finally time to share this project with the world.

While Vortica is still in development, I plan to keep you updated with regular posts here and on our social media accounts. Your support means everything to me, and I'd love for you to follow along on this journey.

Please consider wishlisting Vortica to stay updated on our progress and be the first to know about new developments. Thank you so much for your support!

Stay tuned for more updates!
